headline: 7 Michigan deals, $257.5M raised — led by Sturbridge Diversified Private Equity Fund IV, L.P.

top_deals.company: Sturbridge Diversified Private Equity Fund IV, L.P.
top_deals.summary: Sturbridge Diversified Private Equity Fund IV, L.P., a Birmingham-based private equity fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $255.6M sold to 112 investors.
Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (ESPR) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement with Corstasis Therapeutics Inc.; filing cites a figure of ~$180M.
CloudLaw, Public Benefit Corp, a Traverse City-based technology company, filed a $9.8M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $1.9M sold to 4 investors.

new_funds.company: Sturbridge Diversified Private Equity Fund IV, L.P.
new_funds.summary: Sturbridge Diversified Private Equity Fund IV, L.P., a Birmingham-based private equity fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $255.6M sold to 112 investors.

notable_ma.summary: Mat Ishbia and others reported a 81.7% stake in UWM Holdings Corporation (UWMC) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 13).
Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (ESPR) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement with Corstasis Therapeutics Inc.; filing cites a figure of ~$180M.
Appaloosa LP and others reported a 4.9% stake in Whirlpool Corp (WHR).
Clarkston Ventures, LLC and others reported a 69.7% stake in Presurance Holdings, Inc. (PRHI) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 6).

material_agreements.summary: Cooper-Standard Holdings Inc. (CPS) entered into a material definitive agreement (debt offering).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $257.5M sold across 2 Form D filings this week, up 63% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was CloudLaw, Public Benefit Corp (Traverse City, Other Technology) targeting $9.8M. Good question to ask: are founders in technology favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (ESPR) disclosed a deal with Corstasis Therapeutics Inc.. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan health care & life sciences assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $255.6M raised so far — led by Sturbridge Diversified Private Equity Fund IV, L.P. (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
